facts.text: Bazaruto Island, called Island of the Mist, lies 30 km off the Mozambique mainland.
facts.excerpt: Ilha de Bazaruto, Island of the Mist, lies 30 km off the mainland.

facts.text: On the island, rolling sand dunes run down into clear azure ocean.
facts.excerpt: Here, rolling sand dunes melt into clear azure ocean.

facts.text: Guests can experience the annual humpback whale migration from July to September.
facts.excerpt: experience the annual migration of humpback whales from July to September

facts.text: Guests can swim with dolphins.
facts.excerpt: Swim with dolphins

facts.text: The resort offers sunset dune boarding.
facts.excerpt: Sunset dune boarding

facts.text: Activities include diving, sailing, snorkelling and deep-sea fishing.
facts.excerpt: World-class diving, sailing, snorkelling, deep-sea fishing

facts.text: Beach Pool Villas have a veranda with sun loungers, a plunge pool overlooking the ocean and a tropical outdoor shower.
facts.excerpt: Beach pool villas offer spacious outdoor living, with a veranda and sun loungers with a view. Choose where and when to swim, your plunge pool overlooking the ocean just steps away. Rinse off in your tropical outdoor shower

facts.text: Beach Villas have direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: Direct beach access

facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Sea View Pool Villas are aimed at families, with indoor and poolside dining and lounging overlooking the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Two-bedroom Sea view villas are perfect for families, dine and lounge indoors or poolside overlooking the ocean

facts.text: The resort has a private airstrip and helipad.
facts.excerpt: Private airstrip and helipad

facts.text: Spice Spoons lets guests explore the culinary culture of Mozambique.
facts.excerpt: Embrace the culinary culture of Mozambique with Spice Spoons

facts.text: The resort is a fully inclusive holiday destination.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Bazaruto Island Resort is a Fully-Inclusive holiday destination.

facts.text: The resort has a fitness centre with cardio and weight equipment.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Bazaruto Island Resort has a fitness centre equipped with the latest cardio and weight equipment.

facts.text: On the boat transfer, guests walk through the water to reach the vessel because there is no pier or marina.
facts.excerpt: you will have to walk in the water to reach the vessel on departure and arrival, as there is no pier or marina.

facts.text: A helicopter flight from Vilankulos international airport takes about 15 minutes.
facts.excerpt: Departing directly from Vilankulos international airport. The flight duration is approximately 15 minutes.

facts.text: The resort is a popular family destination.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Anantara Bazaruto Island Resort is a popular family destination.

facts.text: The resort has an Anantara Spa and a Dive Centre.
facts.excerpt: Anantara Spa

facts.text: The resort won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2024.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2018, 2019, 2022, 2024

facts.text: The Anantara Spa is described as award-winning.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning Anantara Spa
